nativeZh: n. 痘病, 痘, 瘟疫

senses.en: a common venereal disease caused by the treponema pallidum spirochete; symptoms change through progressive stages; can be congenital (transmitted through the placenta)
senses.zh: 由屈折性阴道炎引起的常见性病; 症状通过渐进阶段发生变化;可先天性(通过胎盘传播)

senses.en: a contagious disease characterized by purulent skin eruptions that may leave pock marks
senses.zh: 一种传染性疾病,其特征是皮肤暴发,可能留下坑痕。
